## Compact shortlist

### Strongest overall menu direction — **elegant, make-ahead seafood starter + glazed ham**
- **Sainsbury’s Taste the Difference Scottish Smoked Salmon & Maple Terrine, 375g** — **£7.50** (or **£5.60 with Nectar** when the displayed offer applies); serves 5/6.  
  This is my strongest pick: it looks properly celebratory, is ready to eat, and its smoked salmon, maple, orange zest and pink peppercorn profile is a polished opening before a ham centrepiece. It is also made without gluten-containing ingredients in the listed ingredients, but do check the pack at purchase if it is for a coeliac guest. **Left open.**

### Other Sainsbury’s gluten-free-friendly starter directions opened for comparison
- **Taste the Difference Ultimate Prawn Cocktail, 240g** — **£4.95**; serves 3.  
  The classic, cosy British-Christmas route: king and cold-water prawns with brandy Marie Rose sauce and smoked paprika. The ingredient list does not list gluten ingredients; verify the label for your guest.
- **Taste the Difference Pil Pil King Prawns, 135g** — **£4.50**; serves 2, or part of Sainsbury’s displayed “3 for £8” Nectar promotion.  
  The casual party-food option: garlic, smoked paprika, parsley and prawns; Sainsbury’s says eat hot or cold. Again, no gluten ingredient is listed, but check the label.

### Ham: practical headline method
I did open The Kitchn’s spiral-ham page, but its site blocked browser access with a verification wall, so I can’t responsibly present its exact wording or timings as though I had read them. For the terrine-led menu, the sensible headline approach is: **warm the pre-cooked spiral-cut ham gently, tightly covered to retain moisture; apply a sweet/sharp glaze only near the end; then rest briefly and spoon pan juices over the slices.** That keeps the main course low-stress and avoids competing with the refined starter. Use the ham’s packaging for its exact oven temperature and timing.

## Gifts

### M&S stocking-fillers for dads — all under £20
- **M&S 10pk Antibacterial Pure Cotton Handkerchiefs with Sanitized Finish®** — **£16**.  
  My M&S winner: genuinely useful, washable, and considerably less disposable than a novelty gift. M&S shows 463 reviews and a 4.5 rating. **Left open.**
- **M&S Umbrella with Windtech™** — **£12**.  
  A practical winter gift that is easy to use immediately; much more convincing than a token stocking filler.
- **M&S Waxed Cotton Baseball Cap** — **£18**.  
  A durable, weather-appropriate everyday option that feels like a real present rather than clutter.

### Boots men’s fragrance/body-spray sets opened for comparison
- **Old Spice Captain Travel Bag Gift Set with Deodorant Stick, Spray & Shower Gel** — **£15**.  
  Best value of the two for several dads: it explicitly includes the requested body spray plus useful wash and deodorant items, and Boots displayed it as part of its 3-for-2 Christmas Mix & Match offer.
- **Hunter Wash & Mini EDT Set** — **£18**.  
  The better choice when you want something that feels a bit more gift-like: it includes a mini eau de toilette and wash product; Boots also displayed it in the 3-for-2 Christmas promotion. **Left open.**

I left the strongest Sainsbury’s starter (the smoked-salmon and maple terrine) and the two best gift picks for comparison: the M&S handkerchiefs and Boots Hunter Wash & Mini EDT set. Prices and promotions can change, so do a final checkout check.

## Compact shortlist

### Strongest overall menu direction — **elegant, make-ahead seafood starter + glazed ham**
- **Sainsbury’s Taste the Difference Scottish Smoked Salmon & Maple Terrine, 375g** — **£7.50** (or **£5.60 with Nectar** when the displayed offer applies); serves 5/6.  
  This is my strongest pick: it looks properly celebratory, is ready to eat, and its smoked salmon, maple, orange zest and pink peppercorn profile is a polished opening before a ham centrepiece. It is also made without gluten-containing ingredients in the listed ingredients, but do check the pack at purchase if it is for a coeliac guest. **Left open.**

### Other Sainsbury’s gluten-free-friendly starter directions opened for comparison
- **Taste the Difference Ultimate Prawn Cocktail, 240g** — **£4.95**; serves 3.  
  The classic, cosy British-Christmas route: king and cold-water prawns with brandy Marie Rose sauce and smoked paprika. The ingredient list does not list gluten ingredients; verify the label for your guest.
- **Taste the Difference Pil Pil King Prawns, 135g** — **£4.50**; serves 2, or part of Sainsbury’s displayed “3 for £8” Nectar promotion.  
  The casual party-food option: garlic, smoked paprika, parsley and prawns; Sainsbury’s says eat hot or cold. Again, no gluten ingredient is listed, but check the label.

### Ham: practical headline method
I did open The Kitchn’s spiral-ham page, but its site blocked browser access with a verification wall, so I can’t responsibly present its exact wording or timings as though I had read them. For the terrine-led menu, the sensible headline approach is: **warm the pre-cooked spiral-cut ham gently, tightly covered to retain moisture; apply a sweet/sharp glaze only near the end; then rest briefly and spoon pan juices over the slices.** That keeps the main course low-stress and avoids competing with the refined starter. Use the ham’s packaging for its exact oven temperature and timing.

## Gifts

### M&S stocking-fillers for dads — all under £20
- **M&S 10pk Antibacterial Pure Cotton Handkerchiefs with Sanitized Finish®** — **£16**.  
  My M&S winner: genuinely useful, washable, and considerably less disposable than a novelty gift. M&S shows 463 reviews and a 4.5 rating. **Left open.**
- **M&S Umbrella with Windtech™** — **£12**.  
  A practical winter gift that is easy to use immediately; much more convincing than a token stocking filler.
- **M&S Waxed Cotton Baseball Cap** — **£18**.  
  A durable, weather-appropriate everyday option that feels like a real present rather than clutter.

### Boots men’s fragrance/body-spray sets opened for comparison
- **Old Spice Captain Travel Bag Gift Set with Deodorant Stick, Spray & Shower Gel** — **£15**.
